features: AI Face Tracking: Advanced AI face-tracking technology helps keep the subject centered in the frame, making hands-free recording, selfies, vlogging, interviews, and moving-subject videos more convenient.

3.5-Inch Rotating Screen: The large rotating display provides flexible viewing and framing for selfies, vlogs, group recordings, interviews, and creative shooting angles, helping you monitor your content while recording.
48MP High-Resolution Sensor: Capture detailed, high-resolution photos for travel, family occasions, portraits, social media posts, everyday photography, and creative content projects.
Wi-Fi Connectivity: Built-in Wi-Fi allows convenient wireless connectivity with compatible devices, making it easier to transfer, view, and share your captured photos and videos.
Night Vision Mode: Designed to support recording in darker environments, making the camera suitable for evening activities, nighttime adventures, indoor scenes, and low-light content creation.

External Microphone Support: Connect a compatible external microphone for greater audio flexibility, making it suitable for vlogging, interviews, tutorials, presentations, travel videos, and other voice-focused recordings.
description: Capture your everyday adventures, travel memories, family moments, and creative content with this Handheld Action Camera featuring AI Face Tracking, a versatile 3.5-inch rotating screen, and a high-resolution 48MP sensor. Designed for vloggers, travelers, content creators, beginners, and photography enthusiasts, this compact camera combines convenient handheld operation with useful features for capturing photos and videos from different angles. The advanced AI Face Tracking feature helps keep the subject within the frame while recording, making it easier to create engaging videos without constantly adjusting the camera manually. Whether you are filming yourself, recording a family activity, creating travel vlogs, or capturing moving subjects, face tracking provides a convenient way to maintain focus on the person you want to record. A large 3.5-inch rotating screen offers flexible viewing and framing while shooting. The adjustable screen is especially useful for selfies, vlogging, interviews, group videos, and creative low- or high-angle shots.
